Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface TopicSummaryPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
TopicSummaryAdapter
public interface TopicSummaryPort
Outbound port for persisting and retrieving pre-generated topic summaries.

Implementations live in infrastructure/persistence and back onto a JPA repository. The save method uses upsert semantics — calling it with an existing topic overwrites the previous summary.

    • save

      void save(TopicSummary summary)
      Persist a topic summary. If a summary already exists for the same topic, it is overwritten (upsert).
      Parameters:
      summary - the topic summary to save; must not be null
